messages:
Ravi: Heads-up — we kicked off a tiny canary for rwd-nlg:v3.2-q4a (int4-like quant) at 0.5% traffic ~2h ago. Initial telemetry looks promising latency/cost-wise but theres a concentrated regression on the QA slice. posting quick breakdown.

Marta: good to know. how big is the sample?

Ravi: ~3.2k total requests. split table from the smoke eval: 
```
slice, baseline_rougeL, v3.2q4a_rougeL, delta
longform,0.70,0.69,-1.4%
short-answer,0.82,0.81,-1.2%
qa,0.69,0.63,-8.7%
instruction-chat,0.76,0.74,-2.6%
```

Ciara: ouch, qa delta is pretty big. any idea whether it's hallucination severity or answer completeness?

Ravi: automated diff shows higher short-answer truncations and wrong entity spans. hallucination_count per 1k jumps from 12 -> 30. pattern points to lower numeric fidelity in embeddings after quantization rather than decoding temperature shift.

Dong: which quant pipeline/bits? and did you use per-channel or groupwise?

Ravi: per-channel int4 with symmetric zero point, our nvfuser-int4 kernels. config snippet: 
```
quant_mode: per_channel_int4
clamp_strategy: topk_outlier_clamp
kv_cache_dtype: fp16
seed: 2026
profiling: enabled
```

Marta: from rollout policy POV we should not escalate beyond current 0.5% until QA is within 3% RL delta or manual review passes. For auto-fallback I propose: any critical-slice absolute hallucination increase > 1.0 per 1k OR rougeL drop > 3% triggers fallback, subject to min-samples and time window.

Ciara: strongly agree on min-samples. propose min_slice_samples=1500 and eval_window=45m. Also we should require a median-stable check (no flapping).

Dong: add user_feedback_rate and exact-match for QA as secondary signals. user_feedback tends to catch formatting regressions that rouge misses.

Ravi: drafting auto-fallback rule now. rough YAML: 
```
auto_fallback:
  min_slice_samples: 1500
  eval_window: 45m
  dedupe_window: 10m
  triggers:
    - metric: qa_halluc_per_1k_abs
      threshold: 1.0
      severity: critical
    - metric: rouge_l_delta_pct
      threshold: -3.0
      severity: high
    - metric: user_feedback_inc_pct
      threshold: 2.0
      severity: medium
```

sheriff-bot: Canary report (v3.2-q4a) — traffic=0.5% for 2.1h, samples=3200, p50 latency -9%, p95 -14%, token-cost ~-28%, fallback_state=not_triggered.

Marta: action plan: Ravi -> run targeted 15k QA batch (top failing intents) + surface top-200 for human annotation; Dong -> replicate quant locally + run the unit-level exact-match and hallucination scripts; Ciara -> implement min_slice_samples and dedupe_window in gate engine; I'll freeze escalation and hold handoff.

Ciara: small addition 0 I'd like to prototype a composite safety score: score = w1*rouge_drop_norm + w2*halluc_rate_norm*2 + w3*user_feedback_norm. We can tune weights so hallucination carries more penalty.

Ravi: happy to run a calibration sweep. expected timeline: QA batch run completes ~4h, human triage ~8-12h. will post eval link when ready: https://internal/redwood/evals/v3.2-q4a/qa-sweep

Dong: ping when config committed. will test with seed=2026 and identical runtime flags.

Marta: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for the canary decision. We'll only expand to 3% if composite safety score < 0.25 and high-severity hallucination rate < 0.5/1k. :lock:
